# P28.5 — Refresh the public surface off the materialized graph (DEPTH.5)

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/P28.5__refresh-surface-materialized-graph.md` · **Base:** `devin/p28-4-honest-coverage`
· implement-spec full rigor, `live_verification=true` · BUILD_INDEX row 131

## Summary
Re-derive the P27.4 national export (+ the web surfaces) from the now-**materialized** resolution /
relationship / contradiction / coverage tables (P28.1–P28.4) instead of compute-on-read, reconciling the
ADR-092 posture to "materialized" (**ADR-101**, already written at seed — the "ADR-R6-MATERIALIZE-092"
this ticket calls for; cited, not duplicated). The public surface shows **resolved sites** with the honest
"**N resolved sites (from M observations)**" framing, a real §29.3 network, live §31 contradictions, and
honest §32 coverage — and **degrades honestly** to the observation-level framing when the materialized
tables are empty (the hosted state until the deferred hosted materialization runs). No total, ever.

## What changed
- **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — new `read_materialized_resolutions(conn)` read seam (mirrors the
  edge/contradiction seams), completing the P28.1–P28.4 read set the surface consumes.
- **`exports/spine_export.py`** — inside the single `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot, `run_spine_export`
  now also reads the four materialized tables via `fetch_materialized_graph` (each guarded by its
  `input_digest` column and wrapped so an empty/pre-P28 table yields `[]` — honest absence, never a crash,
  never a fabricated count). Pure, unit-testable mappers thread them through `build_spine_export`:
  - `_network` prefers the materialized §29.3 edges (P28.2), else the compute-on-read shaping envelope.
  - `_coverage` prefers the materialized §32 coverage (P28.4), else the shaping metrics; then APPENDS the
    two materialized-graph counted quantities below.
  - `resolved_sites_metric` → the honest "**N resolved sites (from M observations)**" CoverageMetric
    (named denominator = "M observation-level sites carrying coordinate claims"; `is_population_total=false`;
    N ≤ M; carries the provisional-eval disclosure). Returns `None` when no materialized resolution
    intersects a geolocated site → the surface keeps the observation framing.
  - `contradictions_visible_metric` → a "contradictions kept visible" counted quantity (open-of-recorded,
    both evidence sides retained, §3.1). `None` when empty.
  - `_map_layer` describes resolved sites when the resolution graph is materialized, else the launch
    observation-level layer.
  - The materialized §32 coverage rows map to the frozen `CoverageMetric` kinds
    (`CompletenessMethod` → `counted_quantity`/`records_derived_bound`/`reconciliation_ratio`/`survey_recall`).
- **`web/`** — the resolved-sites + contradictions-visible metrics ride the **frozen `CoverageMetric`
  contract**, so they render on the existing landing (`index.astro` `coverage.map`) + coverage page with
  **no new IA / getter / page / schema / client JS**. The two rows are added to the fixture
  `COVERAGE_METRICS` (represents the materialized-graph state; the fixture-export harness serialises them
  into `coverage.json` for export mode too). The P28.1 resolution-eval **PROVISIONAL** disclosure on
  `methodology.astro` is preserved verbatim.
- **`api/store_pg.py`** — no change needed: `_annotation_view` already reads persisted (materialized)
  contradictions first with the compute-on-read fallback — the read-path precedent ADR-101 generalises to
  the export.

## Design decisions
- **Honest degrade, never fabricate.** The hosted materialized tables are empty until the deferred hosted
  materialization runs, so the reads degrade to `[]` and the surface shows the observation-level framing —
  no fabricated hosted resolved-site count. Proven by `test_spine_export_over_seeded_spine` (empty) vs
  `test_spine_export_reads_the_materialized_graph` (seeded).
- **No new IA (out of scope).** The resolved-site + contradiction framing rides the existing frozen
  `CoverageMetric` contract instead of adding a page/getter/artifact/schema.
- **N ≤ M by construction.** Resolved sites are a subset of the observation-level sites — the framing never
  overclaims, and the named denominator keeps §32 "never a total".
